name: @matapao/vindu-app
description: The Vindu browser and Electron workspace for consumer-owned UI sessions.

scripts.compile: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p . && pnpm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild dist/src/renderer.js --bundle --format=iife --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/src/renderer.bundle.js && esbuild dist/src/phone.js --bundle --format=iife --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/src/phone.bundle.js && esbuild dist/src/shell-page.js --bundle --format=iife --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/src/shell-page.bundle.js && esbuild dist/src/keys.js --bundle --format=iife --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/src/keys.bundle.js
scripts.test: node scripts/check-names.mjs && pnpm run compile && vitest run
scripts.test:browser: node dist/test/browser-smoke.js && node dist/test/browser-phone-ask.js && node dist/test/browser-inference.js && node dist/test/browser-shell.js && node dist/test/browser-sdk.js
